rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese pattern for presenting A as an extreme example that nevertheless does B.

example.english: Even children know how to use smartphones.
example.traditional: 連小朋友都識得用手機。
example.jyutping: lin4 siu2 pang4 jau5 dou1 sik1 dak1 jung6 sau2 gei1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a surface or object being flat and level.

example.english: This tabletop isn't even, so the glass of water wobbles.
example.traditional: 呢張枱唔平，擺杯水會搖。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 toi2 m4 ping4 baai2 bui1 seoi2 wui5 jiu4

rows.note: Use 仲 before a comparative or adjective when saying that something is even more so than before or than another thing.

example.english: It is already very cold today, and tomorrow will be even colder.
example.traditional: 今日已經好凍，聽日仲凍。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 ji5 ging1 hou2 dung3 ting1 jat6 zung6 dung3

rows.note: Use 更加 for an explicit or slightly more formal-sounding emphasis of a comparative, especially in careful speech or writing.

example.english: This plan is already good, but the other one is even better.
example.traditional: 呢個方案已經唔錯，另一個更加好。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 fong1 on3 ji5 ging1 m4 co3 ling6 jat1 go3 gang3 gaa1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when amounts, sizes, or proportions are distributed equally.

example.english: The company will split the bonus into even shares for everyone.
example.traditional: 公司將獎金平均分畀大家。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 zoeng1 zoeng2 gam1 ping4 gwan1 fan1 bei2 daai6 gaa1

rows.note: Use this for a steady voice, rate, or condition with little variation.

example.english: Her voice stayed even for the whole hour.
example.traditional: 佢把聲一直好平穩，講咗成個鐘都冇乜變。
example.jyutping: keoi5 baa2 seng1 jat1 zik6 hou2 ping4 wan2 gong2 zo2 seng4 go3 zung1 dou1 mou5 mat1 bin3

rows.note: Use this when money, debts, or mutual claims have been settled so that neither side owes the other anything.

example.english: Once you pay back this amount, we're even.
example.traditional: 今次你還埋條數，我哋就兩清喇。
example.jyutping: gam1 ci3 nei5 waan4 maai4 tiu4 sou3 ngo5 dei6 zau6 loeng5 cing1 laa3
